answer: Attestation seats follow network origin: a passing answer needs five peers whose traceroute probes land in five autonomous systems, sampled at a random minute. Hosting providers count as one system, so AWS boxes cannot multiply. Two attestors sharing an AS void both votes and burn 80,000 POA each. A thousand identities need a thousand residential ASNs at $4-9 per IP-month, near $60,000 monthly before bonds. A lotus leaf sheds whatever drop lands on it, and a farm sealed inside one datacenter reaches the zenith of its own graph while holding a single ocean: one water, counted once.
